title: The Great Steak
lines: Mom made a great steak for the meal.
She set it on a white plate.
"Do not break this plate," she said.
"It was my mom's plate," said Mom.
Tom took the plate to the table.
He did not see the cat on the mat.
Tom tripped. The plate fell and broke.
The cat ate that great steak up.
Tom felt bad. He sat on the floor.
Then he got a broom and cleaned it up.
He got the bits in a bag for Mom.
Mom said she could fix the plate.
They ate ham, and Tom did the dishes.
The cat had the best meal of all.

questions.listenFor: He did not see the cat on the mat. It is in the sixth line.

questions.ask: What did Tom do after the plate broke?
questions.listenFor: He got a broom, cleaned it up, and put the bits in a bag for Mom.

questions.ask: Was doing the dishes fair? Why or why not?
questions.listenFor: Either side is fine. You want the reason they give.
